manifests.description: EffectCraft desktop app
EffectCraft headless CLI: render frames and sequences, run commands, MCP server
EffectCraft in the browser (wasm32): eframe web runner, persistent browser storage (OPFS / IndexedDB), Web Audio, Web Worker renders, PWA, window.effectcraft API
EffectCraft MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio) over a headless session or bridged to the running app's control channel
Clean-room pure-Rust AV1 encoder (Main profile, key and inter frames) for MP4/WebM export, from the AV1 Bitstream & Decoding Process Specification
Effect registry (specs, parameters, categories) and CPU implementations of the effects library
The EffectCraft engine: session, undo history, editor state and the command registry every frontend (UI, CLI, control channel, MCP) dispatches through

Render Queue jobs and output modules: H.264 MP4 (+AAC), ProRes and uncompressed MOV (+PCM) via FilmCraft, HEVC / AV1 MP4 (+AAC) and WebM (VP9 or AV1 + Opus) via EffectCraft encoders, PNG/JPEG/TIFF/EXR sequences, animated GIF, WAV/AIFF
After Effects-compatible expressions: a boa JavaScript runtime with the AE object model (thisComp, thisLayer, wiggle, loopOut, valueAtTime…) and array maths
The GPU compositor (wgpu compute): layer transforms, masks/mattes, the 38 blend modes, motion blur, bit-depth quantisation and GPU effects, with the CPU renderer as the reference
Clean-room pure-Rust HEVC (H.265) encoder (Main / Main 10, I and P slices, CABAC) for MP4 export, from ITU-T H.265
Builds a fully wired EffectCraft session: media decoding (FilmCraft codecs), importer, the expression engine and scripting
Premiere Pro interop through timeline interchange: Final Cut Pro 7 XML (xmeml), FCPXML, OpenTimelineIO and CMX 3600 EDL sequences to and from compositions (via filmcraft-interchange)
Animated values: keyframes, temporal ease (speed/influence), spatial Bezier motion paths, hold/linear/auto interpolation
Lottie JSON import and export: compositions, precomps, shape/solid/null/image/text layers, keyframes with temporal and spatial easing, masks, track mattes and a few effects
Footage import: probing, stills, image sequences, video and audio via FilmCraft's pure-Rust codecs, memory-budgeted frame cache

3D models: glTF 2.0 (.gltf/.glb), Wavefront OBJ/MTL, STL and FBX 7.x (binary and ASCII) import, PBR metallic-roughness materials, node hierarchy, skinning and animation, parametric primitives, and extruded/bevelled outline meshes
Clean-room pure-Rust Opus encoder (RFC 6716 SILK NB/MB/WB, hybrid SWB/FB and CELT FB modes, 48 kHz, 20 ms; RFC 7845 OpusHead) for WebM export audio
Bezier shapes: AE vertex model ⇄ kurbo, parametric shapes, path operations, stroking/dashing and anti-aliased coverage rasterisation

Vector footage import: PDF and PDF-compatible Illustrator (.ai) pages and EPS (a PostScript subset) parsed into the SVG render tree (paths, fills, strokes, shadings, tiling patterns, clipping, text with embedded fonts, images, blend modes, soft masks, optional-content layers)
EffectCraft effect plug-ins: loads sandboxed WebAssembly effect modules (plug-in API v1) into the effect registry
The EffectCraft document: project items, compositions, layers and the After-Effects-style property tree

Photoshop PSD/PSB reader (layers, groups, masks, blend modes, text, layer effects, adjustment layers; 8/16/32-bit, RGB/CMYK/Gray/Lab/Indexed, raw/RLE/ZIP) and a minimal writer, from Adobe's published file format specification
f32 premultiplied RGBA images: sampling, projective warps, blurs, convolution, compositing (rayon-parallel)
The CPU compositor: property evaluation, layer sources (solids, footage, text, shapes, precomps), masks, effects, track mattes, 2D/3D transforms, motion blur and blending
EffectCraft scripting: JavaScript (boa) with an After Effects-style object model (app, project, CompItem, Layer, Property…) over the engine's undoable commands

Swappable trained models for Roto Brush and face tracking: the MaskModel and FaceModel interfaces, a registry of open-licensed models, PyTorch checkpoint and TensorFlow Lite readers, a pure-Rust MobileSAM and MediaPipe Face Landmarker
SVG import: parses SVG 1.1 / SVG 2 static vector content (paths, basic shapes, groups, transforms, use, CSS styles, solid and gradient fills/strokes, opacity) and rasterises it at any scale
Text engine: fonts (bundled OFL + system), shaping (harfrust), bidi, line breaking, paragraph layout and glyph outlines as Bezier paths

Motion tracking: feature/search region point tracking (pyramid normalized cross-correlation + Lucas-Kanade refinement), confidence, corner-pin / transform solves, stabilization, Roto Brush segmentation (graph cut, matting) and 3D camera solving (structure from motion)
The EffectCraft egui frontend (swappable): docking panels, composition viewer, timeline, effect controls, control channel
VP9 encoder (profile 0, 8-bit 4:2:0; intra + inter frames, loop filter, rate control) for WebM export, from the VP9 Bitstream & Decoding Process Specification
Example EffectCraft effect plug-in (WebAssembly, plug-in API v1): posterizes luminance into tinted bands
